hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: A string can be constructed by repeatedly appending zero zeros or one ones.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Let state dp[i] denote the number of valid good strings of length exactly i.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Transition: dp[i] = dp[i - zero] + dp[i - one] modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Linear state transition filling lengths up to high modulo 10^9 + 7.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive branching generates 2^(high / min(zero, one)) states.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Array of size high + 1 stores counts per length.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes linear DP summation across range [low, high].
